title: Sign assigned along a path
statement: Let a path on $n$ coordinates have an assignment in $\mathbb F_2$ or no assignment at each coordinate, and let its terminal output be a sign. For a coordinate $i$ in the path's support (the coordinates with an assignment), its required sign is the sign encoding of the assigned bit at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A path with sign-valued terminal output
